question: T starts from Point A and drives 6 km towards the North. He then takes a right turn, drives 15 km, turns right and drives 9 km. He then takes a right turn and drives 19 km. He takes a final right turn, drives 3 km and stops at Point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A again? (All turns are 90 degrees turns only unless specified)
solution:
Given:

T starts from Point A and drives 6 km towards the North.

He then takes a right turn, drives 15 km, turns right and drives 9 km.

He then takes a right turn and drives 19 km.

He takes a final right turn, drives 3 km and stops at Point P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/06660541d83b0b0fadff9d688b01a0bec50e43536e3ed271bf5bc31357bd9b07.png] 

Thus, T should drive 4 km in the east direction in order to reach Point A again.​

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
